extractor_notes.blockers: Abbott earnings PR is financial-only; clinical catalysts live in segment R&D materials
extractor_notes.tier0_overlap_check: Q1 2026 earnings PR contains only retrospective device readouts (VERITAS Amulet 360 closure rates, FreeDM2 FreeStyle Libre HbA1c reduction, AtaCor EV-ICD collaboration announcement) and full-year financial guidance. No PDUFA, FDA approval, CE Mark, device launch, or clinical readout dates are disclosed. The companion 8-K filed Apr 17 2026 is a shareholder derivative settlement notice with no clinical content.
